lines.en: label kirinsoccer20:
scene kirinthinking1
So begins another day beside a calculated disaster.
lines.zh: 于是，又一个待在一场精心算计的灾难身边的日子开始了。

lines.en: I wasn’t particularly fond of that title when I first heard it in Kirin’s dorm room, but after putting a bit more thought into it, I think it works quite well.
lines.zh: 我第一次在 Kirin 的宿舍里听到这个称号的时候并不是特别喜欢，但多琢磨了一下之后，我觉得它相当贴切。

lines.en: In a sense, I’m also a calculated disaster of sorts.
lines.zh: 从某种意义上说，我也算是一场精心算计的灾难。

lines.en: And no, that is not another excuse for me to be self-deprecating. I already have plenty of those.
lines.zh: 而且不，那不是我自我贬低的又一个借口。那种借口我已经够多了。

lines.en: It’s a fair evaluation based on my tendency to change or mold myself to fit the ideals of those around me.
lines.zh: 这是基于我那种为了迎合身边人的理想而改变或塑造自己的倾向，所做出的公正评价。

lines.en: But I’ve never been fond of changing, so the transformation is always a bit incomplete.
lines.zh: 但我从来都不喜欢改变，所以这种转变总是不太彻底。

lines.en: Imagine you buy sixteen puzzles, all with at least one or more pieces missing. (It was a really shitty puzzle store.)
lines.zh: 想象一下，你买了十六副拼图，每一副都至少缺了一块或者更多。（那是一家特别烂的拼图店。）

lines.en: And you have a friend who makes puzzles for a living.
lines.zh: 而你有个以做拼图为生的朋友。

lines.en: An enigmatologist, if you will.
lines.zh: 如果你愿意的话，可以叫他谜题学家。

lines.en: The enigmatologist says to you-
lines.zh: 谜题学家对你说——

lines.en: “I can likely craft you the missing piece based on a description of it, but there is a chance the size will be slightly off without the proper schematics.”
lines.zh: “我大概能根据你的描述给你做出那块缺失的拼片，但没有合适的图纸，尺寸有可能会稍微差一点。”

lines.en: Of course, that problem could be easily remedied if you’d just bring him the puzzle so he can figure out exactly what it is that’s needed.
lines.zh: 当然，只要你把拼图带过来，让他看看具体缺的是什么，这个问题很容易就能解决。

lines.en: But you’re a fucking lazy dick and don’t want to be bothered making a second trip.
lines.zh: 可你是个又懒又欠的混蛋，懒得再跑一趟。

lines.en: So you have him guess and ultimately wind up with a piece that is slightly off.
lines.zh: 所以你让他猜，最后拿到一块稍微差一点的拼片。

lines.en: But you still take it from him and just mash it into the puzzle anyway, not caring if it causes the rest to snap or break or whatever it is that happens when you try to solve a puzzle with brute force.
lines.zh: 但你还是从他手里接了过来，硬把它塞进拼图里，根本不管那会不会让其他部分崩开、断裂，或者你用蛮力解拼图时会发生的任何事。

lines.en: And everything comes falling down.
lines.zh: 然后一切就轰然倒塌。

lines.en: Everything but me, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，除了我之外的一切。

lines.en: For I am both the enigmatologist as well as the one who was too lazy to ever provide the schematics.
lines.zh: 因为我既是那个谜题学家，也是那个懒得提供图纸的人。

lines.en: I am both the cause of all problems as well as their respective solution.
lines.zh: 我既是所有问题的起因，也是它们各自的解法。

lines.en: A makeshift god who can provide temporary solace, but never truly guide someone toward salvation.
lines.zh: 一个能给予短暂安慰，却永远无法真正指引谁走向救赎的临时神明。

lines.en: And as long as puzzles with missing pieces exist, I will continue to ruin them.
lines.zh: 而只要有缺块的拼图存在，我就会继续毁掉它们。

lines.en: Because an enigmatologist does not just create puzzles, they solve them as well.
lines.zh: 因为谜题学家不只是创造谜题，他们也要解开谜题。

lines.en: And if all of the puzzles in all of the world are solved, what is left for me to do?
lines.zh: 而如果全世界所有的谜题都被解开了，那还剩什么是我能做的？

lines.en: Break puzzles to make new puzzles.
lines.zh: 打碎谜题，制造新的谜题。

lines.en: Fuck it. Take every puzzle you bought from that shitty store and dump the contents into a giant bowl.
lines.zh: 去他的。把你从那家烂店买的所有拼图都倒进一个大碗里。

lines.en: Maybe even a well.
lines.zh: 甚至是一口井里。

lines.en: Create the ultimate puzzle.
lines.zh: 造出终极谜题。

lines.en: Solve it.
lines.zh: 解开它。

lines.en: Become God.
lines.zh: 成为神。

lines.en: Thank you for once again listening to my incessant ramblings about all that is broken and how to both fix and unfix it.
lines.zh: 感谢你再一次听我喋喋不休地念叨一切破碎之物，以及该如何修好它、又该如何弄坏它。

lines.en: : So...I’m thinking about quitting the team.
lines.zh: : 所以……我在考虑退出球队。

lines.en: : Is this about the sit-ups again?
lines.zh: : 这又是因为仰卧起坐吗？

lines.en: : Nah.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Frankly, I was a little more disappointed that Miku wouldn’t let you into the showers with us despite clearly wanting it.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我更失望的是 Miku 明明很想，却不让你跟我们一起进淋浴间。

lines.en: : So Miku’s prudence is the reason you’re thinking of quitting?
lines.zh: : 所以 Miku 的矜持是你想退出的理由？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking2
: Nah.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I’m just thinking it might be time to move onto something I’m a little better at.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，也许是时候去做点我更擅长的事了。

lines.en: : Like, I’ve been playing soccer for pretty much my entire life and have always been a middle-of-the-road player at best.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我几乎一辈子都在踢足球，可最好也不过是个中不溜的球员。

lines.en: : I still think it’s fun and everything, but it gets kind of annoying at times.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得它挺有意思的，但有时候也挺烦的。

lines.en: : Like, you try so hard to improve...only to watch everyone else get better without putting in even half of the effort.
lines.zh: : 就比如，你那么努力想进步……却只能眼睁睁看着别人连你一半的力气都不用就变得更强。

lines.en: : I don’t really think it’s fair to say that they’re putting in less effort when, more often than not, it’s the two of {i}us{/i} up here rather than them.
lines.zh: : 但更多时候是{i}咱们俩{/i}在这上头而不是她们，所以说她们付出的努力更少，我觉得不太公平。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking3
: Who says that I don’t spend every waking moment outside of practice practicing?
lines.zh: : 谁说我训练之外就没有醒着的每一刻都在练习了？

lines.en: : I think you might have the wrong idea of what “practice” and “outside of practice” are supposed to consist of.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能对“练习”和“训练之外”该是什么样子有什么误解。

lines.en: : Maybe I just like practicing alone better?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是更喜欢一个人练习？

lines.en: : Because you’re self-conscious?
lines.zh: : 因为你难为情？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking4
: What’s wrong with being a little self-conscious?
lines.zh: : 稍微有点难为情又怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m a [teenage]girl surrounded by other [teenage]girls who are naturally better at almost everything than me.
lines.zh: : 我是一个[teenage]女孩，周围全是几乎在任何事上都天生比我强的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : Of course I’m going to be self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 我当然会难为情。

lines.en: : Do you think that makes me weak, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那让我很软弱吗，老师？

lines.en: : No. I think it makes you human.
lines.zh: : 不。我觉得那让你更像个人。

lines.en: : Which is a good thing because I’ve definitely questioned that about you on several occasions.
lines.zh: : 这倒是件好事，因为我确实有过好几次怀疑你到底是不是人。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking5
: What else would I be if not a human?
lines.zh: : 如果不是人，我还能是什么？

lines.en: : A puzzle.
lines.zh: : 一个谜题。

lines.en: : Like a jigsaw puzzle or...a crossword puzzle?
lines.zh: : 像拼图……还是填字游戏？

lines.en: : Whichever one is harder for the average person to solve, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概哪个对普通人来说更难解，就是哪个吧。

lines.en: : Probably a jigsaw puzzle, then. Those can get kind of intense once you start adding a bunch of pieces.
lines.zh: : 那大概是拼图了。一旦块数多起来，那东西会变得相当要命。

lines.en: : But I guess crossword puzzles can also get intense once you start adding crazy words like-
lines.zh: : 不过我猜填字游戏一旦开始加些疯狂的词也会变得很要命，比如——

lines.en: : Enigmatology?
lines.zh: : 谜题学？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking6
: Yeah. Whatever that is.
lines.zh: : 对。管它是什么呢。

lines.en: : How is anyone supposed to guess a word that they’ve never even heard before?
lines.zh: : 一个你从来没听过的词，谁能猜得出来啊？

lines.en: : I mean, I guess it’s easier now since we all have access to the Internet, but still. That’s way too much work.
lines.zh: : 我是说，现在我们都能上网了，大概容易点了吧，但还是。那也太费劲了。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking7
: See that girl with the crazy thighs over there? The one with the ball in her hands?
lines.zh: : 看见那边那个大腿特别疯狂的女孩了吗？手里拿着球的那个？

lines.en: : That is your sister, Karin. I am quite familiar with her.
lines.zh: : 那是你姐姐，Karin。我可相当熟悉她。

lines.en: : Yeah, whatsherface.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个谁。

lines.en: : She and I actually used to team up and put jigsaw puzzles together when we were little. Like, way before we were even in elementary school.
lines.zh: : 我和她小时候其实会组队一起拼拼图。就是，还没上小学那会儿。

lines.en: : Neither of us were particularly good at them on account of being stupid little kids but, just like with soccer, she got better and I lagged behind.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都拼得不太好，毕竟只是两个蠢小孩，但就跟足球一样，她越来越强，而我落在后面。

lines.en: : Now, this club is pretty much the only thing the two of us ever do together.
lines.zh: : 现在，这个社团基本是我们俩唯一还会一起做的事了。

lines.en: : So you can probably guess how that makes me feel.
lines.zh: : 所以你大概能猜到那让我是什么感受。

lines.en: : Not really any point in guessing when you’re already making it extremely apparent.
lines.zh: : 你已经表现得很明显了，猜也没什么意义。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking8
: Hey, when a puzzle gets too hard, what do you do?
lines.zh: : 嘿，当一个谜题变得太难的时候，你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Do you give up?
lines.zh: : 放弃吗？

lines.en: : Or do you keep working at it no matter how tough it gets?
lines.zh: : 还是不管多难都继续啃下去？

lines.en: : No clue. But I’ll let you know how I feel the next time something like that happens to me.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过等下次我碰上这种事，我会告诉你我的感受。

lines.en: : Bummer.
lines.zh: : 真扫兴。

lines.en: : I was hoping to find out what you’re planning on doing with me.
lines.zh: : 我本来还想知道你打算拿我怎么办。

lines.en: : You know, since I’m just as much of a puzzle as I am a human being to you.
lines.zh: : 毕竟在你眼里，我既是一个人，也是一个谜题。

lines.en: : Once you’ve got all the outer pieces put together, are you really going to go through all of the effort to finish the rest?
lines.zh: : 一旦你把外圈的拼片都拼好了，你真的还会费那个劲把剩下的拼完吗？

lines.en: : Or are you just going to call it quits and move onto another?
lines.zh: : 还是干脆收工，换下一个？

lines.en: : I mean, we all know the outer part of the puzzle is the most fun. So why bother doing the rest when there are puzzles literally everywhere?
lines.zh: : 我是说，谁都知道拼图最有趣的就是外圈。既然到处都是拼图，那何必还费劲拼剩下的？

lines.en: : What would the equivalent of that be if we’re counting you entirely as a person and not an object?
lines.zh: : 如果把你完完全全当成一个人、而不是一个物件来算，那相当于什么？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking9
: I guess it would be just...getting close enough to fuck me, proceeding to {i}actually{/i} fuck me, and then running off to fuck somebody else when you realize I’m not worth fucking anymore.
lines.zh: : 大概就是……近到能上我，然后{i}真的{/i}上了我，等你发现我不值得再上，就跑去上别人。

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 或者差不多吧。

lines.en: : So it all comes back to sex.
lines.zh: : 所以又绕回性了。

lines.en: : It all comes back to sex.
lines.zh: : 又绕回性了。

lines.en: : I mean, that’s how our relationship started, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们的关系就是这么开始的，不是吗？

lines.en: : A promise that you could have what you want from me as long as I can have what I want from you.
lines.zh: : 一个承诺——你能从我这里拿到你想要的，只要我也能从你那里拿到我想要的。

lines.en: : Luckily, we both want the same thing now.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，现在我们想要的是同一样东西。

lines.en: : Who’s to say either one of us will want to finish the rest of the puzzle once the outline is done?
lines.zh: : 谁能保证一旦轮廓拼完，我们俩有谁会想把剩下的拼完？

lines.en: : Sure, I guess there’s some momentary satisfaction once you actually {i}solve{/i} a puzzle.
lines.zh: : 当然，你真{i}解开{/i}一个谜题的时候，确实会有那么一瞬间的满足感。

lines.en: : But after that, you just break it apart and put it back in the box or use that weird puzzle glue to hang it on the wall or the fridge.
lines.zh: : 但之后，你就把它拆开装回盒子里，或者用那种奇怪的拼图胶把它挂到墙上或冰箱上。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’d look particularly nice hanging on my wall.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你挂在我墙上不会特别好看。

lines.en: : I don’t even think you’d {i}fit{/i} on my wall.
lines.zh: : 我甚至觉得你{i}挂不上{/i}我的墙。

lines.en: : Hell, I’m not even sure if you’ll fit in {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我都不确定你装不装得进{i}我{/i}身体里。

lines.en: : So it all comes back to sex.
lines.zh: : 所以又绕回性了。

lines.en: : It all comes back to sex.
lines.zh: : 又绕回性了。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking10
Kirin looks away from me, watching the rest of the girls practice.
lines.zh: Kirin 把视线从我身上移开，看着其余的女孩训练。

lines.en: I can’t say for certain, as I still haven’t completed her outline, but I’m pretty sure she’s hoping that one of them looks over at her right now.
lines.zh: 我不能肯定，因为我还没拼完她的轮廓，但我相当确定她现在正盼着她们当中有人看过来。

lines.en: That someone smiles and coaxes her into coming down and practicing with them instead of abandoning her atop this stage filled with athletic bags and traffic cones.
lines.zh: 盼着有人对她微笑，哄她下来和她们一起训练，而不是把她丢在这个堆满运动包和交通锥的台子上。

lines.en: At the same time, though, Kirin abandoned {i}them{/i}.
lines.zh: 但同时，也是 Kirin 先抛弃了{i}她们{/i}。

lines.en: They’ve abandoned each other, so it wouldn’t make any sense for one of them to reach out.
lines.zh: 她们抛弃了彼此，所以其中一方主动伸手并不合情理。

lines.en: It’s just an unfortunate yet realistic progression of one’s interests and confidence dwindling with the passage of time.
lines.zh: 这只是一个人的兴趣与自信随时间流逝而衰减的、不幸却现实的进程罢了。

lines.en: Time is the worst.
lines.zh: 时间是最糟糕的东西。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll just find something to do with Noriko.
lines.zh: : 也许我干脆去找点跟 Noriko 一起做的事。

lines.en: : She’s fun to be around. And she’s yet to make me feel insignificant, so that’s pretty sweet.
lines.zh: : 和她在一起很开心。而且她到目前为止还没让我觉得自己无足轻重，那可相当不错。

lines.en: : You two are still getting along?
lines.zh: : 你们俩还处得不错？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking11
: We’re kind of like two sides of the same coin.
lines.zh: : 我们有点像同一枚硬币的两面。

lines.en: : We’ve got our differences and will probably never have the same exact mindset as one another, but we’re still out to do the same thing at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 我们有分歧，大概永远不会有完全一样的心态，但说到底我们还是在做同一件事。

lines.en: : Is that “thing” having sex with me?
lines.zh: : 那件“事”是和我上床吗？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking12
: I was talking more about filling a void in our hearts, but I guess the sex thing is also true.
lines.zh: : 我说的更多是填补我们心里的空洞，不过上床那件事大概也对。

lines.en: : Am I just a tool to you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说我只是个工具吗？

lines.en: scene kirinthinking13
: You’re kind of a tool in general.
lines.zh: : 你总的来说就是个工具。

lines.en: : I did not come here to be insulted.
lines.zh: : 我可不是来这儿受侮辱的。

lines.en: : A useful tool. Like a hammer or a...chainsaw.
lines.zh: : 一个有用的工具。像锤子或者……电锯。

lines.en: : Or a vibrator.
lines.zh: : 或者按摩棒。

lines.en: : I guess it’s your turn to turn everything sexual now?
lines.zh: : 那现在轮到你把什么都说成性了吗？

lines.en: : You did it twice in a row earlier, so now I have to catch up.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚连着来了两次，所以现在我得追上来。

lines.en: : From this point on, it’s anyone’s game.
lines.zh: : 从现在开始，谁都有机会。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking14
: That aside, things have definitely started to look up a bit since Noriko and I moved in together.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，自从我和 Noriko 搬到一起住，事情确实开始好转了一点。

lines.en: : I always knew getting out of my parents’ house would be great for me, but combining that with a cool, new roommate and a teacher I actually like-
lines.zh: : 我一直知道搬出父母家对我有好处，但再加上一个又酷又新的室友和一个我真心喜欢的老师——

lines.en: : So it all comes back to sex...
lines.zh: : 所以又绕回性了……

lines.en: : Stop fucking saying that when I’m trying to hand you a puzzle piece.
lines.zh: : 我正想递你一块拼图的时候，别他妈说这个。

lines.en: : Oh, we’re working together now?
lines.zh: : 哦，那我们现在是一起拼了？

lines.en: : I just thought we were solving our own puzzles in the same room as one another.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我们只是在同一个房间里各拼各的。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking15
: Doesn’t mean we can’t check in on each other’s progress every now and then.
lines.zh: : 那也不代表我们不能时不时看看对方的进度。

lines.en: : Basically, I’m just saying that life is changing for me.
lines.zh: : 基本上我就是想说，我的人生在改变。

lines.en: : Still have no clue if it’s a good change or a bad one, but it’s definitely something. And I’ve been dying for {i}something{/i} for years.
lines.zh: : 还是不知道那是变好还是变坏，但确实是某种变化。而这些年我一直都渴望{i}有点什么变化{/i}。

lines.en: scene kirinthinking16
: Thanks a lot for being such a horrible person. I was starting to think other people like me didn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 多亏了你是个这么糟糕的人。我刚开始还以为像我这样的别人是不存在的。

lines.en: : Oh, we’re everywhere. You just need to figure out how to identify us.
lines.zh: : 哦，我们到处都是。你只需要学会怎么认出我们来。

lines.en: : I found out how to identify {i}you{/i} pretty easily. Just had to lift my skirt and offer up my v-card.
lines.zh: : 我认出{i}你{/i}倒是挺容易的。只要掀起我的裙子、把我的第一次交出去就行了。

lines.en: : Pretty sweet deal in exchange for being able to feel my heart beat again, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 换回一颗能重新跳动的心，这买卖挺划算的，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Hopefully I’ll be able to feel that someday too.
lines.zh: : 希望有一天我也能感觉到那个。

lines.en: : My heart or yours? Cause you can touch my chest pretty much any time you want. Just not sure if this is the best place for it and all.
lines.zh: : 我的心还是你的心？因为你想摸我的胸随时都行。只是不太确定现在这地方合不合适之类的。

lines.en: : I meant mine. But I will gladly grope you in front of any amount of girls.
lines.zh: : 我说的是我的。不过在任何数量的女孩面前摸你我都乐意。

lines.en: : Grope away, good sir.
lines.zh: : 那就摸吧，好先生。

lines.en: scene black
I reach out for Kirin’s chest.
lines.zh: 我伸手去摸 Kirin 的胸。

lines.en: She closes her eyes and-
lines.zh: 她闭上眼睛，然后——

lines.en: : S-Sensei! The heck are you doing over there?!
lines.zh: : 老——老师！你在那边搞什么鬼？！

lines.en: : Trying to feel whole again.
lines.zh: : 想重新感觉到完整。

lines.en: : Help! I’m being assaulted!
lines.zh: : 救命！我被性骚扰了！

lines.en: : You fucking traitor.
lines.zh: : 你这个叛徒。

lines.en: : Miku! Come save me!
lines.zh: : Miku！快来救我！

lines.en: : Sensei! Start doin’ ‘yer job and put all those friggin’ traffic cones back into the storage room!
lines.zh: : 老师！干点你的正事，把那些该死的交通锥都放回储藏室去！

lines.en: : Why did you even bring them onto the stage if you weren’t going to use them?
lines.zh: : 你既然不用，干嘛还把它们搬到台子上来？

lines.en: : {i}Ahh...Sensei...{/i}
: And why is Kirin making these noises?
lines.zh: : 还有 Kirin 为什么在发出这种声音？

lines.en: : Because you’re grabbin’ her friggin’ boob! Girls react to stuff like that!
lines.zh: : 因为你在摸她该死的胸！女孩对这种事是有反应的！

lines.en: : This is a thing I absolutely did not know as it is my first time ever touching a woman and has definitely never happened before this moment in time.
lines.zh: : 这件事我绝对不知道，因为这是我第一次摸女人，而且在这一刻之前绝对从未发生过。

lines.en: : I don’t care how many times it’s happened, I-
lines.zh: : 我不管这种事发生过多少次，我——

lines.en: : Well, actually...I think I kinda do care.
lines.zh: : 嗯，其实……我觉得我好像还挺在意的。

lines.en: : But just let her go and do ‘yer job!
lines.zh: : 但你先放开她，去干你的活！

lines.en: I [[reluctantly] listen to Miku and stop groping Kirin.
lines.zh: 我[[reluctantly]听了 Miku 的话，不再摸 Kirin。

lines.en: She winks at me before adjusting her bra and skipping over to Miku in the middle of the gym.
lines.zh: 她朝我眨了下眼，整理好胸罩，蹦蹦跳跳地跑向体育馆中央的 Miku。

lines.en: I wonder if she’s actually going to follow through with quitting the team or if that was just another one of many of her momentary lapses in judgement.
lines.zh: 我在想她是不是真的会退出球队，还是说那只是她众多一时判断失误中的又一次。

lines.en: But I guess there’s no way of knowing without waiting to see how things play out.
lines.zh: 但我想，除了等着看事态怎么发展，也没有别的办法知道。

lines.en: Until then, I will keep solving puzzles.
lines.zh: 在那之前，我会继续解谜题。

lines.en: Or creating them.
lines.zh: 或者创造谜题。

lines.en: Or all of the above.
lines.zh: 或者以上皆是。
